pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which final is written with two dots on top? (1 mark)
   A. ü
   B. e
   C. o
   D. u

2. What does 谁 (shéi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Love
   B. Who
   C. Younger sister
   D. Older brother

3. What does 客厅里有电视 mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like television
   B. There is a television in the living room
   C. The television is in the kitchen
   D. The living room is on the television

4. Fill the blank: 冰箱____厨房。 (The fridge is in the kitchen.) (1 mark)
   A. 在
   B. 有
   C. 上
   D. 是

5. What are the three steps of good imitation? (1 mark)
   A. Read, draw, colour
   B. Talk, sleep, walk
   C. Copy, hide, forget
   D. Listen, repeat, compare and correct

6. Which Chinese word means "today"? (1 mark)
   A. 清真寺 qīngzhēnsì
   B. 明天 míngtiān
   C. 今天 jīntiān
   D. 休息 xiūxi

7. What does 明天 (míngtiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tomorrow
   B. To go
   C. To rest
   D. Mosque

8. What does 祝 (zhù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. They
   B. Cup
   C. Knife
   D. To wish

9. Fill the blank: 我____茶。 (I drink tea.) (1 mark)
   A. 吃
   B. 喝
   C. 去
   D. 看

10. What does 干旱 (gānhàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Weather
   B. Also
   C. It rains
   D. Drought

11. Which word is pronounced hóngshuǐ? (1 mark)
   A. 洪水
   B. 云
   C. 太阳
   D. 天气

12. Which is an extreme weather event? (1 mark)
   A. 太阳 the sun
   B. 风 a light breeze
   C. 洪水 a flood
   D. 云 a cloud

13. What does 请再说一遍 qǐng zài shuō yí biàn mean? (1 mark)
   A. Thank you very much
   B. Please say it once more
   C. Please sit down
   D. Good morning

14. What does 上面 (shàngmiàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Bathroom
   B. Above
   C. Door
   D. Garden

15. Which sentence means "Hello, teacher!"? (1 mark)
   A. 老师好!
   B. 你呢?
   C. 再见!
   D. 我叫小明。

16. What does 儿子 (érzi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Son
   B. Is, am, are
   C. Older brother
   D. Home, family

17. What does 教堂 jiàotáng mean? (1 mark)
   A. Mosque
   B. School
   C. Church
   D. House

18. Which character is the number five? (1 mark)
   A. 九
   B. 七
   C. 三
   D. 五

19. What does 一 (yī) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Three
   B. One
   C. Eight
   D. Ten

20. Which word is pronounced shénme? (1 mark)
   A. 什么
   B. 牛奶
   C. 蔬菜
   D. 零食

21. What does 两 liǎng mean in 两只眼睛? (1 mark)
   A. Three
   B. Two
   C. Big
   D. One

22. Which Chinese word means "hello"? (1 mark)
   A. 你好 nǐ hǎo
   B. 再见 zàijiàn
   C. 叫 jiào
   D. 老师 lǎoshī

23. What does 家 (jiā) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Daughter
   B. Home, family
   C. Older sister
   D. Son

24. Which word completes 卧室里有____? (There is a bed in the bedroom.) (1 mark)
   A. 桌子
   B. 花园
   C. 床
   D. 冰箱

25. What does 五 (wǔ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Four
   B. Seven
   C. Five
   D. Nine

26. Which Chinese word means "ten"? (1 mark)
   A. 九 jiǔ
   B. 十 shí
   C. 五 wǔ
   D. 三 sān

27. What does 星期四 (xīngqīsì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Thursday
   B. Seven
   C. To go
   D. Three

28. How many strokes does 生 have? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 5
   C. 7
   D. 6

29. What does 云 (yún) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Small
   B. It rains
   C. Cloud
   D. Not

30. Which sentence means "Today it rains."? (1 mark)
   A. 今天天气很好。
   B. 风很小。
   C. 今天下雨。
   D. 这是太阳。

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Where is the television?" (2 marks)

32. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The bathroom is beside the garden." (3 marks)

33. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 吃 and 前面. (2 marks)

34. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 水, 没有 and 门. (3 marks)

35. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my eyes to see." and "I use my ears to hear." (4 marks)

36. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 听 and 雨. (2 marks)

37. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 来 and 笑. (2 marks)

38. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 九 and 号. (2 marks)

39. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The sofa is beside the door." and "The bathroom is beside the garden." (4 marks)

40. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is a banana." (2 marks)

41. Break the syllables hǎo, jiào and nǐ into initial and final. (3 marks)

42. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The wind is very strong." (2 marks)

43. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 学校 and 看. (2 marks)

44. Give three things to do when planning a showcase item. (3 marks)

45. Give three tips for neat Chinese handwriting. (3 marks)

46. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 窗户 and 大家. (2 marks)

47. Give three tips for reading aloud clearly in Mandarin. (3 marks)

48. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Where is the sofa?" (2 marks)

49. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The wind is very strong." and "Today it rains." (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #16 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — ü
   The lips-rounded sound ee is written ü, with two dots.

2. B — Who
   谁 (shéi) means who.

3. B — There is a television in the living room
   里 is inside and 有 is there is.

4. A — 在
   在 means is at or is in.

5. D — Listen, repeat, compare and correct
   Good imitation means listening carefully, repeating, then comparing with the speaker.

6. C — 今天 jīntiān
   今天 (jīntiān) means today.

7. A — Tomorrow
   明天 (míngtiān) means tomorrow.

8. D — To wish
   祝 (zhù) means to wish.

9. B — 喝
   We drink tea, so we use 喝.

10. D — Drought
   干旱 (gānhàn) means drought.

11. A — 洪水
   洪水 is pronounced hóngshuǐ and means flood.

12. C — 洪水 a flood
   洪水 hóngshuǐ is a flood.

13. B — Please say it once more
   It is a polite way to ask for a repeat.

14. B — Above
   上面 (shàngmiàn) means above.

15. A — 老师好!
   老师好! (lǎoshī hǎo!) means "Hello, teacher!".

16. A — Son
   儿子 (érzi) means son.

17. C — Church
   教堂 is a church.

18. D — 五
   五 wǔ is five.

19. B — One
   一 (yī) means one.

20. A — 什么
   什么 is pronounced shénme and means what.

21. B — Two
   两 is two when counting things.

22. A — 你好 nǐ hǎo
   你好 (nǐ hǎo) means hello.

23. B — Home, family
   家 (jiā) means home, family.

24. C — 床
   A bed belongs in the bedroom.

25. C — Five
   五 (wǔ) means five.

26. B — 十 shí
   十 (shí) means ten.

27. A — Thursday
   星期四 (xīngqīsì) means Thursday.

28. B — 5
   生 has five strokes.

29. C — Cloud
   云 (yún) means cloud.

30. C — 今天下雨。
   今天下雨。 (jīntiān xià yǔ.) means "Today it rains.".

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: 电视在哪儿? diànshì zài nǎr?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: 浴室在花园旁边。 yùshì zài huāyuán pángbiān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: 吃: chī, to eat. 前面: qiánmiàn, in front of.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: 水: shuǐ, water. 没有: méiyǒu, there is not. 门: mén, door.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

35. (4 marks)
   Answer: 我用眼睛看。 wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn. 我用耳朵听。 wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: 听: tīng, to listen, to hear. 雨: yǔ, rain.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: 来: lái, to come. 笑: xiào, to laugh, to smile.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: 九: jiǔ, nine. 号: hào, date (day of the month).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

39. (4 marks)
   Answer: 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān. 浴室在花园旁边。 yùshì zài huāyuán pángbiān.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是香蕉。 zhè shì xiāngjiāo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: hǎo = h + ao; jiào = j + iao; nǐ = n + i.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct syllable.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: 风很大。 fēng hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: 学校: xuéxiào, school. 看: kàn, to look, to see.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Choose an item, decide who does what, list the materials and words needed, practise several times.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Keep characters the same size, keep strokes firm and straight, leave equal spaces, write in the right stroke order, do not join separate strokes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: 窗户: chuānghu, window. 大家: dàjiā, everybody.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Look at the whole line first; find the tones; read slowly and clearly; pause at punctuation; speak loudly enough for everyone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: 沙发在哪儿? shāfā zài nǎr?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

49. (4 marks)
   Answer: 风很大。 fēng hěn dà. 今天下雨。 jīntiān xià yǔ.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.
